meta.name: inspired-product
meta.description: Build empowered product teams using discovery and delivery dual-track. Use when the user mentions "product discovery", "empowered teams", "feature factory", "opportunity assessment", "product vision", "product strategy", "what should we build", or "our roadmap is just a feature list". Also trigger when restructuring teams away from output-driven models, or deciding what to build next based on outcomes. Covers discovery techniques, team structure, opportunity assessment, vision/strategy, and continuous delivery. For customer interviews, see mom-test. For ongoing discovery systems, see continuous-discovery.

copy.tagline: 用双轨发现与交付打造高绩效产品团队
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你们团队正从功能工厂转向成果驱动的产品模式。
